description: Erection of a temporary consultation cabin located next to the existing Tesco store entrance
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of two years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Osterley Tesco/Location001; OsterleyTesco/Site001; DQ2867 (Rev A)  Received:  05 August 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - TThe building hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 23 September 2021.
Condition : 5 - The temporary consultation cabin hereby approved shall only operate between 08:00am to 09:00pm Monday to Friday, 10:00am to 6:00pm on Saturday and 10:00am to 4:00pm on Sundays.
